podcast.description: The New York Times' daily news podcast — today's top story in 20 minutes.

stories.title: Elon Musk made a $1 billion investment in Skydance, report says
stories.description: The investment will provide a much needed financial boost as the company seeks to cut costs and lift its stock price.

stories.title: Meta shocked by $25B fine after N.M. refused to join multistate settlement
stories.description: Meta will appeal a ruling imposing the largest fine Mark Zuckerberg has ever seen.

stories.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
stories.description: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

stories.title: US-backed vaccine trial on babies canceled after international outcry
stories.description: The decried trial was canceled last week before police seized vaccine doses.

stories.title: Prepare for supply chain disruption from cyber or climate emergencies, Streeting warns public
stories.description: The defence secretary says the UK needs to be ready for scenarios including impact to essential supply chains.

stories.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
stories.description: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

stories.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
stories.description: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

stories.title: AI discovered a massive cyber-security flaw - here's what happened
stories.description: The BBC's technology correspondent Joe Tidy explains how it happened, and what it means for you.

stories.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
stories.description: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

stories.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
stories.description: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

stories.title: ‘Longer we wait, worse it gets’: Struggle of Gaza’s breast cancer patients
stories.description: Breast cancer patients in Gaza face delayed diagnoses, medicine shortages and limited access to scans and treatment.

stories.title: Foreign national beaten to death by a mob in South Africa
stories.description: Police say a 50-person mob in Durban killed a man amid a wave of anti-migrant marches.

stories.title: Sri Lanka beat England to overcome Harry Brook hitting fastest 200 in ODIs
stories.description: England captain Brook hits 202 in record ODI time, but Sri Lanka hit a six to win by two wickets with one ball to spare.

stories.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli soldier abusing cat goes viral
stories.description: A video of an Israeli soldier throwing a cat over a fence has gone viral online.

stories.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
stories.description: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

stories.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
stories.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

stories.title: Moderna’s stock tumbles after reported leak of data for cancer vaccine
stories.description: Moderna and Merck are expected to share the Phase 3 data for their experimental cancer vaccine this weekend at a medical conference.

stories.title: Elon Musk invests about $1 billion in Skydance
stories.description: David Ellison's father, billionaire and Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, has a history with Musk.

stories.title: Bill Ackman says 2027 will be an amazing year for stocks as wars, inflation ease
stories.description: "We're going to have an amazing 2027," he said.

stories.title: Meta stock sinks 6% as AI spend pushes free cash flow negative
stories.description: Prices for the social media giant's five-year credit default swaps are reaching all-time highs as investors signal growing credit concerns.

stories.title: Elon Musk promised a SpaceX share to every kid in America — don’t hold your breath
stories.description: Trick or treat? Musk has a long record of saying things have little relation to reality.

stories.title: The Social Security Administration wants more babies signed up for ‘Trump accounts.’ But there’s still a catch.
